rows.grounds: epithet describing cyclical return; nominative singular masculine
epithet or name Sadāśiva; sadā (always) + śiva (auspicious)

items.question: What qualities characterize Sadāśiva in this sequence of divine epithets?
premises: Sadāśiva is described as revolving or returning.
Sadāśiva possesses a withdrawn or inward-turned nature.
Sadāśiva embodies a mass of dharma.
items.inference: Sadāśiva unites cyclical activity, inward withdrawal, and the fullness of dharma in a single auspicious identity.
uncertainties: Whether samāvartta refers to cosmic cyclical return or a specific ritual or yogic turning is not explicit.
items.plain_english: He is revolving, of withdrawn nature, a mass of dharma, and ever-auspicious.
